subject: Anna Callahan Candidate Statement
overview: First-term incumbent Anna Callahan presented her re-election platform, focusing on her past legislative record and her unique model for community-driven governance through volunteer policy teams.

items.title: Candidate Statement
items.summary: Incumbent Anna Callahan discussed her first-term achievements in budget stabilization and rodent control while promoting her model of community engagement through volunteer policy teams. These teams facilitate legislative research, neighborhood listening sessions, and specific initiatives for tree planting and housing affordability.
